description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of exchange with effect from 30.03.2020 to 01.04.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new exchange rates for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial/commercial transactions related to imports/exports, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure types. The mention of the Director General is incidental to the regulatory function.
